_comment: Harness config. Override per-workdir or in ~/.config/opencode-usage-coach/harness.config.json. provider: which codexbar quota to watch (empty = codexbar default). lighterModel: suggested when throttling. Free models have no quota -> never gated. domainMaxNodes: cap on domain DB nodes injected into generate/investigate prompts (default 12; unset/0 uses the default).
